description: This file is a shell script used for managing the diagnostic LEDs on a device running OpenWrt firmware, handling different device states like preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and done.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the trigger setting for the status LED based on the device configuration.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED behavior based on the current device state such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
